model.name: R19.68: File access is room-scoped — only room members may read/download a room's files.
model.description: SECURITY: file access (read/download of uploaded FileUnits) MUST be authorized per room membership. Only authenticated members of a room may access that room's files. The server MUST validate that the requesting user's token is in the room's members[] before serving file content. Unauthenticated or non-member requests return 403. This prevents cross-room file leakage and unauthorized access to uploaded content.

discoverySource.diagnosisExcerpt: File access endpoints serve content without checking room membership — any user with the file uuid can download any room's files.

model.crossRefNote: R19.35 (Room.members[] IOR refs) provides the membership check source. R19.46 (Room.files[] IOR list) identifies which files belong to which room.
